name: table
title: Table
description: Responsive HTML table primitives with condensed tabular numeric columns and hoverable rows.
docs: Set numeric on TableHead and TableCell to right-align metrics and render cell numerals in the condensed tabular font. Mark selected rows with data-state="selected".

export type TableHeadProps = {
  /** Aligns the column header to the right for numeric values. */
  numeric?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<TableHeadProps>(), {
  numeric: false,
})

  delete rest.class

})
</script>
